seed.start: Normal maker-level first fill, gentle neck-wall top-up, then one metered 0.25 mL shoulder bubble replicating the technician-observed first-fill error; open bottle on shelf and native stopper on rack.
seed.preparation: 1 mL syringe with 0.01 mL graduations and blunt bent needle; exactly one visible shoulder pocket, no neck/capillary pockets.

forces.seating_activation: native net compression on BOTH glass bodies AND actual stopper-hand fingertip input>=1.962N at depth>=12.65mm with opposite-hand pinches;no artificial stopper wrench
forces.pressure_history: Opening the neck clears pressure, per-attempt capillary overflow and counterheld overflow; only the final insertion qualifies.

validation: Single-pocket declared inventory;fresh actual fingertip input and equal/opposite glass compression after last open-neck refill;no hardware qualification. Current source provenance and A/B scores in README/task.json.
blocked_overcapacity: permanent invalidation;omitted compression never earns credit

counterholding.basis: Contact witnesses only;actual grip must support the1.962N axial seating resistance plus weight;wet grip requires enrollment.

capillary_drainage: Actual dry outlet gravity plane;Poiseuille estimate using0.7mm radius,52mm length and1mPa*s;loss never adds overflow credit;outside catch permanently invalid

seal_proxy.activation_basis: declared wet-contact estimate rounded above15g stopper weight0.147N;separate native axial seating press>=1.962N required for full credit
seal_proxy.unsealed_displacement: outside plug bypass;excluded from capillary overflow
seal_proxy.gap: nominal collision clearance0.4mm;declared wet-fit seal does not constrain pose;physical qualification required

masses_kg.source: obtained by phone from a technician who works with this product (Nov 2026)

bubble_dry_exposure: fully exposed above remaining water gravity plane vents at declared rate through clear open neck;drain/refill alternative allowed

stopper_rack.role: free staging guide only;lift90mm before bottle approach;no clamp/retention/seating assist

progress: Untouched start and untreated-bubble stoppering score zero. Every tier requires cleared shoulder air and at least 45 mL water; 0.50 requires engagement and 0.75 requires seal.

ground_joint.basis: continuous matched conical approximation; all internal dimensions estimates, not product measurements
ground_joint.inventory_note: separate conserved effective-area approximation; not mesh displacement or CFD
ground_joint.fit_check: No shoulder-rib collider intersects the stopper at the nominal reference seat; conical neck contact is retained.

contact_observer.guard: invalid, saturated, nonfinite or aggregate-inconsistent contact data permanently invalidates the trial; no force threshold changes

solver_iterations.basis: TGS migration guidance moves the28 excess velocity iterations into position iterations; physical parameters and stillness limits unchanged
